text: ‘Global inequality is best explained by the continuing impact of colonialism.’ Evaluate this view.
OR
‘Global migration has entirely negative consequences for migrant groups.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
Section B: Media
EITHER
‘Media content is controlled by the owners of the media.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘The new media is a powerful tool through which people are able to challenge government
authority.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
Section C: Religion
EITHER
‘Rather than uniting people in society, religion is a source of conflict.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘Religious organisations have little influence in society today.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
